source_summary: Tall monochrome ink Chinese landscape with layered mountains, mist bands, pine-covered ridges, small village and pavilion architecture, winding stream, rocks, shrubs, and foreground trees. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_pine_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the massive upper-left mountain mass with rounded summit, steep washed slopes, dark contour strokes, and rows of tiny pines crowning the top and ridgelines.
must_preserve: soft grey ink wash on broad slopes
arched contour lines descending from summit
dense dark pine needles along the crest
small dotted trees on ridgelines
rocky darker right edge and lower foothill transitions

motifs.name: distant_right_mist_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant peaks on the upper-right middle distance, including the tall vertical peak, smaller pointed silhouettes, and the darker nearer knoll with pine strokes.
must_preserve: faint mist-softened peak silhouettes
tall narrow right peak with blurred wash edge
dark ribbed brush strokes on nearer knoll
small pine marks at bases
soft atmospheric fading into surrounding void

motifs.name: central_mist_belt
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal mist layer crossing the painting between the upper mountains and middle hills, keeping the soft blank-cloud openings and partially submerged tree and ridge edges.
must_preserve: soft uneven mist edges
blank paper-like cloud openings
partially obscured lower mountain bases
faint tree tops emerging through fog
transparent grey wash transitions

motifs.name: mid_left_terraced_village
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left hillside village cluster with small angular roofs nestled among trees, terraced slopes, shrubs, and surrounding rounded rocks.
must_preserve: thin roof geometry and stacked house lines
dark tree crowns around dwellings
terraced slope contours
rounded rock forms with ink texture
small vertical trunks and shrub dots

motifs.name: central_pine_ridge_network
motifs.description: Isolate the central layered ridges and pine groves, including the diagonal ridge spine, clustered hilltops, dark dotted rock accents, and scattered small trees.
must_preserve: diagonal ridge linework
dark moss-dot rock accents
vertical pine trunks and needle clusters
alternating pale wash slopes and dark texture bands
small hidden architectural roof marks if visible within the ridge

motifs.name: cliffside_bridge_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left middle hamlet beside the narrow descending stream, including the rectangular buildings, arched bridge-like crossing, cliff walls, and nearby vertical tree stands.
must_preserve: small rectangular roof and wall geometry
arched bridge or covered crossing over the stream
vertical falling-water channel
tight cliff contours around the ravine
fine trunks and dark foliage enclosing the buildings

motifs.name: foreground_stream_boat_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower central winding waterway with pale stream surface, low boat form, small footbridge or rope-like crossing, stepping stones, banks, and surrounding foreground rocks.
must_preserve: thin horizontal water ripples
curved low boat silhouette
small crossing line with posts
scattered stepping stones in the stream
rounded bank rocks with dotted texture
soft wet washes along the shore

motifs.name: right_foreground_pavilion_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right pavilion compound beneath the large dark foreground tree, including bamboo-like trunks, leafy canopy masses, hut rooflines, and rocky base.
must_preserve: large branching tree trunk with dark foliage masses
fine bamboo or slender vertical trunks
small pavilion roof and wall outlines
rocky mound at the base with moss dots
contrasting dark ink foliage against pale washes
delicate ground lines around the building

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
